Удастся ли ему раскрыть их и спасти жизни людей? Сможет ли журналист выжить в таинственном городе? А выбраться из него? - Узнавайте в мистическом сериалы "Дневники Темного".

programme.title: Семейные мелодрамы
programme.desc: Это не выдуманные истории, а реконструкция реальных событий, которые могут случиться с каждой семьей. В каждой семье свои "Семейные мелодрамы", конфликты, накопившиеся проблемы с долговыми ямами, изменами, трудными детьми и конфликтами с родителями. Какой выход из этих ситуаций, достигших наивысшего апогея, когда никто не хочет его искать? Как же тогда жить дальше? Эти фильмы не заканчиваются хэппи-эндом, но, тем не менее, они будут интересны самому широкому кругу зрителей: от самых маленьких до людей в возрасте. Сюжет фильма обычно предполагает некое размышление или обсуждение, потому что он поднимает важные философские вопросы, заставляет задуматься о понятиях "любовь", "дружба", "верность", "предательство". Помимо главной мелодраматической линии отношений героев, фильмы из подборки "Семейных мелодрам" содержат и философский, и морально-нравственный подтекст, и авторскую позицию по ключевым вопросам бытия. Вместе с тем, это не нудное поучительное рассуждение. Ленты также повествуют о личном выборе героя в сложных жизненных обстоятельствах, которые будут близки всем зрителям.

programme.title: Cleanskin
programme.desc: Harry (Sam Douglas), a British people arms dealer, is seen in bed with a prostitute named Rena (Shivani Ghai). While toying with Harry's pistol, she unloads it but replaces the empty magazine. Harry's bodyguard Ewan (Sean Bean) is a British Secret Intelligence Service. Harry and Ewan travel to a bank, transporting a briefcase of Semtex. The men are followed by two terrorists, Ash (Abhin Galeya) and Ibrahim (Mens-Sana Tamakloe). Ibrahim approaches Harry and Ewan from the top of a staircase, shooting at them. After Ash shoots Ewan twice, Harry tries to shoot Ash, only to discover there are no bullets in his gun. Ash kills Harry and takes the briefcase of Semtex. However, Ewan manages to shoot Ash in the arm; but, before he can apprehend him, Ash returns fire and escapes with the briefcase.

programme.title: Out of Season
programme.desc: When a young drifter is forced to stay the winter in a small seaside town, he inadvertently becomes the catalyst for deceit, double crossings and murder amongst the locals.

programme.title: First Kill
programme.desc: Wall Street broker Will Beeman (Hayden Christensen) has been struggling with being present for his wife Laura (Megan Leonard) and son Danny (Ty Shelton). Shortly after hearing of Danny being bullied at school, Will decides to take his family to his hometown, Granville, Ohio in order to bond with Danny. Upon entering Granville, Will is reacquainted with Police Chief Marvin Howell (Bruce Willis), a family friend who at one point dated his aunt, Dottie (Deb G. Girdler). Howell advises Will on taking precaution after informing him of a recent bank robbery. While teaching Danny how to hunt with a rifle, Will and Danny witness a heated exchange between two men, one of them holding the other at gunpoint. The unarmed man (Gethin Anthony) is shot in the shoulder after throwing a key near Will's position at a shooting station, attracting the gunman's attention. The gunman opens fire on Will, prompting Will to shoot him with his hunting rifle in self-defense. Upon inspecting the gunman, discovers that the gunman was a police officer who failed to identify himself. Distraught, Will brings the wounded man to the family cabin in order for Laura, a hospital nurse, to provide first aid.

programme.title: Operation Chromite
programme.desc: In 1950, just a few months after North Korean forces have overrun most of South Korea, an American-led United Nations Command is deployed to Korea to aid the struggling South Koreans. General Douglas MacArthur devises a secret plan to attack behind enemy lines at the port city of Incheon. The risky strategy is opposed by leaders of the other military branches, forcing MacArthur to devise a clandestine operation to gather essential information from within occupied Incheon by coordinating a weeklong South Korean intelligence operation known as "X-Ray".

programme.title: Lost in Florence
programme.desc: When Eleroo advises Bumblelion to make a wish when getting the biggest part of the wishbone, it means trouble for poor Rhinokey for losing two bank bags of money. Bumblelion starts spending the money and looses his friends while Rhinokey manages to escape from Officer Eaglebeagle. Rhinokey tries to convince Bumblelion to return the bank bags, but Bumblelion decides to run off thinking that Rhinokey wants to steal his money. Soon after, Bumblelion realizes how Rhinokey lost the bank bags and returns the money to the police.

programme.title: Above & Beyond
programme.desc: Two cop partners, who are also best friends attend a domestic disturbance, only for one to accidentaly critically wound the other. The rest of the police force are suspicious that there may have been no accident.

programme.title: McCinsey's Island
programme.desc: A former secret agent finds a treasure map and decides to find the loot. But he is not the only one.

programme.title: Irish Jam
programme.desc: A South Central L.A. con artist with rap skills tries to keep bill collectors and his lover, with marriage in mind, at bay by entering a poetry contest staged by a small Irish town. Can his rhyming skills help the town and win him the prize money?

programme.title: Almost Friends
programme.desc: Charlie, a culinary genius, has lost the motivation. He doesn't know what to with his life anymore, but he knows one thing - get close to Amber. In comparison to her boyfriend, he seems to be totally unattractive, but Charlie's closest friend convinces him that where there's a will there's a way.

programme.title: Malpractice
programme.desc: The first episode of a medical crime thriller series following a team of investigators as they uncover corruption and negligence. Dr Lucinda Edwards is a smart and experienced A and E doctor in the midst of a nightmare shift - she has a gunshot victim and an opioid overdose patient who both need a bed in resus, but there's only room for one of them. When one of the patients dies, Lucinda realises that her troubles have only just begun as she faces a probe by the Medical Investigation Unit.

programme.title: Con Man
programme.desc: The story of Barry Minkow, a young charismatic business man who becomes a wealthy CEO by lying, cheating and stealing his way to the top.

programme.title: Edith
programme.desc: After the death of his wife Edith, Jake feels like he has lost the chance to confront his past. He is convinced that Edith is haunting him for having lived a lie and for having never challenged her about the legitimacy of their son. "Edith" explores how we move on from bereavements. How we make peace with our past and find something worth living for.

programme.title: Score: A Hockey Musical
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Farley has led a sheltered life, raised on a diet of home schooling, organic living and trips to the art gallery. To his parents' dismay, Farley loves to play hockey with the local kids. To their even greater dismay, Farley is scouted and signed by the owner of a junior league team, where he becomes an instant star. But Farley discovers that stardom comes with a price - including the expectation to fight on the ice. Throw in a changing relationship with his best friend, and Farley finds himself losing his way.

programme.title: Max Cloud
programme.desc: A space cruiser crash lands on the purple planet of Heinous, an intergalactic prison that is home to the most vile and dangerous villains in the galaxy. All of the crew have perished except for its pilot; intergalactic space hero Max Cloud, the ships hapless chef Jake, and its reluctant Commander, Rexy. Their mission is simple, wait inside their vessel until help arrives and try their best to keep the prisoners outside from getting in, however this is Max Cloud and he doesn't do simple. ...But this is not real life. This is a video-game, and at the helm of the adventure is Sarah, a teenage video game fanatic who immerses herself in fantasy to avoid dealing with her less than packed social life and a strained relationship with her dad, straight laced single parent Tony. After a fallout, Tony bans Sarah from playing games and in a frenzy of teenage emotion Sarah makes a wish, that in the blink of an eye becomes a reality... With a flash of pixelated light Sarah is transported into the video game by the mysterious Space Witch, who exists in an etherial void, behind a secret door, that never appears in the same place twice! So Sarah finds herself trapped inside the game and the only person who can help her is her equally socially defunct but incredibly charming friend, Cowboy, who must control Sarah from her bedroom in Brooklyn and keep her from losing her one life, in a game that can't be paused, that they have never finished before! To make matters worse Sarah has not found herself inside the body of the wonderful Max Cloud, but Jake, that's right... the hapless chef. We follow Sarah as she negotiates the terrifying and dangerous planet of Heinous alongside the ever confident Max and fed up Rexy, jumping back and forth with the real world as the pressure mounts on Cowboy and the real stakes start to rise. They soon encounter stranded Bounty Hunter, Brock Donnelly, and realise they must get off the planet before help arrives as the planets surface burns so hot every day that anything not underground is space liquid! AND to add to the stakes Cowboy must keep his best friend away from the evil clutches of the games villain Revengor, a part man, part machine, lunatic who is hell bent on taking Max Clouds ship and with an army of prisoners and an evil sorcersss called SHEE, his chances look pretty damn good. The action bounces between the video game and the real world as Cowboy and Sarah must come together to get her home, all leading to the ultimate showdown in Revengors lair, where back in Brooklyn, video game expertise arrives in the form of a very unlikely hero. Sit down. Plug in. It's time to play THE INTERGALACTIC ADVENTURES OF MAX CLOUD.

programme.title: Unknown Energies, Unidentified Emotions
programme.desc: A hybrid of animated, experimental, feature and genre film in found footage technique, with a radio phonic sound and of unexpected, almost 40-minute duration. Journalist Isidor Dukas visits the Institute for Research on Psychic Phenomena and Mental Film when a confrontation with one of the test subjects transforms a routine check into a never-ending maze. Barić's work calls into question issues surrounding artistic practices in the digital age including ideas about authenticity, simulation/replication and appropriation.

programme.title: Looks That Kill
programme.desc: Max Richards, a teenage boy born with a medical condition of being lethally attractive, who is changed forever when he meets Alex, a girl with her own bizarre ailment, who aids him on his quest of self-discovery... without accidentally killing someone.

programme.title: The Good Girl
programme.desc: A discount store clerk strikes up an affair with a stock boy who considers himself the incarnation of Holden Caulfield.Justine is a sullen 30-year-old woman stuck in a dead-end job at the Retail Rodeo department store.In addition to her mind-numbing occupation, Justine also has to contend with her dim-witted husband, Phil, and his partner, Bubba, who work as house painters when they aren't smoking pot and staring blankly at the television.Justine sees an opportunity for change, however, when she meets Holden, a fellow Retail Rodeo employee who is even more depressed than herself.The young Holden and Justine soon begin a passionate secret affair, unaware that it may not be so secret after all.

programme.title: Snowbound
programme.desc: Liz tells her old friend Barbara that she believes her ex-husband is stalking her. She plans to leave town for awhile and stay at a cabin in the mountains. Barbara invites herself along and when it seems that Dale has followed them to the cabin, Barbara discovers she doesn't know Liz as well as she thought.

programme.title: Knock Off
programme.desc: Marcus Ray (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sales representative for "V SIX" jeans, and his partner, Tommy Hendricks (Rob Schneider), are about to be busted for selling "knock off" jeans (a low-quality imitation of well-known products). Their American contact, Karen Leigh (Lela Rochon), who is not only their employer but a CIA agent sent to find the mole in their operation, is threatening them with a jail term if they do not prove their innocence.

programme.title: Dot.Kill
programme.desc: A detective tries to hunt down a serial killer who broadcasts his murders live on the internet.

programme.title: Fight Valley
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead after getting involved in an underground fighting ring. Her sister Windsor begins training under a respected ex-fighter as she searches for the killer.

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: Young Jim Hawkins and Peg-legged Long John Silver set sail for adventure in Robert Louis Stevenson's classic tale of dastardly pirates, swashbuckling heroes, buried treasure, and a young boy's courage during the adventure of a lifetime.

programme.title: Corner Office
programme.desc: Orson, a compulsive bureaucrat who discovers a secret room.

programme.title: The Sandman
programme.desc: One fine morning, Benno finds sand in his bed. While he tries to ignore this at first, he soon must realize that he himself is loosing the sand. Day after day the sand increases and soon his time literally starts running short. Finally he is left no choice but to ask Sandra for help, who runs a small coffee shop under his apartment. Although Benno hates her with a passion, he started having dreams of her every night. What could Sandra and the dreams have to do with the sand?

programme.title: Owd Bob
programme.desc: A teen orphan spends the summer on Isle of Man with estranged grandpa. Despite loving dogs, they want summer to end. Boy befriends neighbor girl, but her father has history with grandpa. Locals suspect neighbor's dog kills sheep at night.

programme.title: My Dad's Christmas Date
programme.desc: Ever since his wife died, David struggles to get on with his teenage daughter Jules. She feels hemmed in and misunderstood, and he finds himself more and more powerless and lonely. In order to find a new partner for her dad and someone to talk to for herself, Jules creates online profiles on dating sites for David. Things suddenly take a funny turn, because although there is no shortage of candidates, they all fall short of David's ... and Jules's expectations. Will everything take a fresh turn on Christmas? A funny, heartwarming story in a wonderful Xmas mood!

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.

programme.title: Foolproof
programme.desc: Kevin, Samantha and Rob live for Foolproof; their own private club where through high-tech, meticulously thought out and executed plans, they pull off the most impossible of heists - all in theory that is. They've never actually done it for real. But all that changes when Leo, a cutthroat British gangster, rips off their foolproof plans for a diamond heist and uses it to successfully execute the robbery. Threatening to implicate them, Leo blackmails them to pull off a robbery worth $20 million in corporate bonds.

programme.title: The Magnificent Ambersons
programme.desc: The spoiled rotten and utterly unlikable rich kid George Amberson becomes horrified when his recently widowed mother rekindles her relationship with the wealthy Eugene Morgan, who she left decades earlier in order to marry George's father. As George struggles to sabotage his mother's new romance, he must deal with his own romantic feelings for Morgan's daughter and the consequences of his meddling as his once great family falls into ruin due to his machinations...

programme.title: Second Acts
programme.desc: When a woman reports her daughter as missing, the Blue Heelers find she has moved in with her schoolteacher.

programme.title: Unexpected
programme.desc: Music critic Bob is out of a job, addicted to Zoloft, and trying to wrangle the menagerie of animals that his wife Linda has accumulated. Will adopting a baby cure their existential angst? Or should they just rescue another duck?

programme.title: Musketeers Forever
programme.desc: A group of ex-secret agents opens a Jazz Club in Las Vegas. When they discover that a local Indian reservation is being threatened by a greedy and powerful gangster, they act. All for one, and one for all!

programme.title: The Number One Girl
programme.desc: Joey is a big Hollywood action star and a martial arts champ. When he gets invited to be a celebrity judge at friend and mobster Molnar's request he falls for Molnar's Number One Girl. She is strictly off limits and so Joey must engage in a duel to the death with Molnar and his five bodyguards.

programme.title: Hangman
programme.desc: Mystery movie. American mystery, produced in 2017. Retired homicide detective Ray Archer and his partner, ex FBI agent Will Ruiney, are assigned to track down a vicious serial killer, who is playing a twisted version of the children's game 'Hangman'.

programme.title: House of
programme.desc: Trapped in a deserted house, nine people must play a deadly game of survival.

programme.title: Black Cop
programme.desc: A black police officer gets pushed to the edge after he is profiled and assaulted by the colleagues he worked side by side with, so he decides to get revenge and take his frustrations out on the community that he swore to protect.

programme.title: The Howling: Reborn
programme.desc: In the sequel to The Howling. On the eve of his high school graduation, unremarkable Will Kidman finally bonds with the girl he has long yearned for, reclusive Eliana Wynter. But he also discovers a dark secret from his past... that he is about to become a werewolf. 1 Jul 13, in an effort to fight destiny and save their love as well as their lives, they must battle not only Will's growing blood lust but an army of fearsome beasts bent on killing them... and then, us all.

programme.title: Sairuss
programme.desc: Džons ir šķīries pusmūža vīrietis, kas samierinājies ar domu par dzīvi vientulībā. Bijusī sievas, kas joprojām ir viņa labākā draudzene, gandrīz ar varu aizved Džonu uz viesībām, kur viņš iepazīstas ar savu sapņu sievieti - Molliju. Abi sāk tikties un drīz vien iemīlas, taču Mollijas greizsirdīgais dēls Sairuss, kuram ar māti ir īpaši ciešas attiecības, sāk traucēt abu laimei.

programme.title: Pilns bruņojums
programme.desc: Pragmatisks ASV jūras kājnieks savām acīm redz Vjetnamas kara dehumanizējošo ietekmi uz saviem kolēģiem - sākot no brutālajām apmācības nometnēm līdz asiņainajām ielu kaujām Huē.

programme.title: Slow TV
programme.desc: Saulains kajaka brauciens.

programme.title: Kas skatāms Filmzone?
programme.desc: Iepazīstinām ar Filmzone filmām.

programme.title: Slepkavu pārītis
programme.desc: Spensers Eimzs ir cilvēks, kuru valdība agrāk nolīgusi, kad vien vajadzējis klusu un slepeni no kāda tikt vaļā. Viņš savu darbu vienmēr ir paveicis operatīvi un bez pēdām, pretī saņemdams daudz dažādu labumu, turklāt komandējumos apceļodams visu pasauli. Par spīti dzīves baudīšanai ar ātrām mašīnām un eksotiskām sievietēm, Spensers nezin kā pamanījies iemīlēties Dženā Kornfeldā, bezrūpīgā datoru ekspertē, kas tolaik centusies atgūties no neveiksmīgām attiecībām. Pēc trim gadiem Spensers un Džena ir laimīgi precējušies un ļaujas mājas dzīves idillei. Uz papēžiem min Spensera trīsdesmitā dzimšanas diena. Pēkšņi viņš ar sievu atklāj, ka ikdienas laimei kuru katru mirkli var pienākt nežēlīgs gals. Kāds par Spensera galvu ir izsolījis atlīdzību vairāku miljonu apmērā. Aizdomās ir jātur ikviens - sākot no veikala kasieres, beidzot ar kaimiņu rūgumpodu.

programme.title: Sairuss
programme.desc: Džons ir šķīries pusmūža vīrietis, kas samierinājies ar domu par dzīvi vientulībā. Bijusī sievas, kas joprojām ir viņa labākā draudzene, gandrīz ar varu aizved Džonu uz viesībām, kur viņš iepazīstas ar savu sapņu sievieti - Molliju. programme.title: Amerikāņu psihopāts
programme.desc: Patriks Beitmens ir pārticis, izskatīgs un veiksmīgs brokeris, kurš bauda luksusa dzīvi – sievietes, narkotikas un visu, ko sirds kāro. Tomēr viņam kaut kā pietrūkst – dzīves jēgas. Šo tukšumu Patriks aizpilda ar sadistiskām slepkavībām, par saviem upuriem izvēloties skaistas sievietes. Tā kā viņš nogalina bez acīmredzama motīva, policistam Donaldam Kimbelam ir gandrīz neiespējami nonākt uz Beitmena pēdām. Tomēr kādu dienu inspektors pieklauvē pie slepkavas biroja durvīm...

programme.title: Patriotu diena
programme.desc: Režisors: Pīters Bergs. Lomās: Marks Vālbergs, Džons Gudmens, Kevins Bēkons, Mišela Monegana, Dž. K. Simonss, Alekss Volfs, Temo Melikadze, Melisa Benuā. Filmas pamatā ir traģiskie notikumi Bostonas maratonā 2013. gadā. Uzreiz pēc sprādzieniem policijas seržants Tomijs Sonderss un FIB aģentu komanda uzsāka teroristu meklēšanu. Brāļu Carnajevu notveršana izrādījās viena no sarežģītākajām un spraigākajām operācijām policijas vēsturē. Režisors Pīters Bergs un aktieris Marks Vālbergs rekonstruējuši teroristu nodomus un to realizāciju, kas izdzēsa vairākas dzīvības un sakustināja iluzorās drošības pamatus. Patriotu diena ir viena no ASV Austrumu krasta oficiālajām brīvdienām, un kopš 1969. gada Masačūsetsas štatā to atzīmē aprīļa trešajā pirmdienā. Tās nozīmīgākais notikums ir Bostonas maratons, kam ir vairāk nekā 100 gadus senas saknes, un 2013. gadā tas pārvērtās par slaktiņu, ko pirms finiša līnijas noorganizēja divi Kirgizstānā dzimuši brāļi. Divus gadus pēc Bostonas maratona traģēdijas rakstnieks Keisijs Šērmens un Bostonas žurnālists Deivs Vedžs izdeva grāmatu, kas atklāja 2013. gada aprīļa notikumus. Tā kļuvusi par pamatu scenārijam, kas pārvērsts asa sižeta trillerī ar Marku Vālbergu, Džonu Gudmenu, Kevinu Bēkonu, Dž. K. Simonsu un Mišelu Monegani galvenajās lomās.

programme.title: Ķeceris
programme.desc: Divas jaunas misionāru meitenes klauvē pie kādas mājas durvīm. Tās atver omulīgais misters Rīds, kurš viņas aicina iekšā. Ātri vien meitenes apjēdz, ka nokļuvušas velnišķīgā slazdā un šī ir spēle uz dzīvību un nāvi.

programme.title: Amerikāņu psihopāts

Brāļu Carnajevu notveršana izrādījās viena no sarežģītākajām un spraigākajām operācijām policijas vēsturē. Režisors Pīters Bergs un aktieris Marks Vālbergs rekonstruējuši teroristu nodomus un to realizāciju, kas izdzēsa vairākas dzīvības un sakustināja iluzorās drošības pamatus. Patriotu diena ir viena no ASV Austrumu krasta oficiālajām brīvdienām, un kopš 1969. gada Masačūsetsas štatā to atzīmē aprīļa trešajā pirmdienā. Tās nozīmīgākais notikums ir Bostonas maratons, kam ir vairāk nekā 100 gadus senas saknes, un 2013. gadā tas pārvērtās par slaktiņu, ko pirms finiša līnijas noorganizēja divi Kirgizstānā dzimuši brāļi. Divus gadus pēc Bostonas maratona traģēdijas rakstnieks Keisijs Šērmens un Bostonas žurnālists Deivs Vedžs izdeva grāmatu, kas atklāja 2013. gada aprīļa notikumus. Tā kļuvusi par pamatu scenārijam, kas pārvērsts asa sižeta trillerī ar Marku Vālbergu, Džonu Gudmenu, Kevinu Bēkonu, Dž. K. Simonsu un Mišelu Monegani galvenajās lomās.

programme.title: Amerikāņu psihopāts
programme.desc: Patriks Beitmens ir pārticis, izskatīgs un veiksmīgs brokeris, kurš bauda luksusa dzīvi – sievietes, narkotikas un visu, ko sirds kāro. Tomēr viņam kaut kā pietrūkst – dzīves jēgas. Šo tukšumu Patriks aizpilda ar sadistiskām slepkavībām, par saviem upuriem izvēloties skaistas sievietes. Tā kā viņš nogalina bez acīmredzama motīva, policistam Donaldam Kimbelam ir gandrīz neiespējami nonākt uz Beitmena pēdām. Tomēr kādu dienu inspektors pieklauvē pie slepkavas biroja durvīm...

programme.desc: Džons Viks - reiz leģendārs algotais slepkava, kas pārtraucis savu nodarbi pēc savas sievas nāves. programme.title: Profesionālis
programme.desc: Kad bijušais nāvējošo cīņu dalībnieks Lūks Raits nejauši sastopas ar 11 gadus vecu ķīniešu meitenīti Meju, kuru vajā tie paši gangsteri, kas savulaik nogalināja viņa sievu, viņš nolemj iesaistīties - un pēkšņi nonāk pašā vidū Ņujorkas ietekmīgāko bandu karā ar augstām likmēm. programme.title: Labākais manī
programme.desc: Lai gan Amanda un Davsons nāk no dažādiem sociālajiem slāņiem, viņu mīlasstāsts, kurš sācies jau pusaudžu vecumā, ir pierādījums tam, ka dvēseļu radinieki eksistē. Sibilla ir pieredzējusi psihoterapeite, kas vēlas atteikties no prakses, lai pievērstos sena sapņa īstenošanai. Sapnis ir uzrakstīt grāmatu. programme.title: Mājā
programme.desc: Franču valodas skolotājs Žermēns ir vīlies savu audzēkņu vājajos rakstu darbos un zaudējis aizrautību ar skolotāja profesiju. Taču kādu dienu viņa uzmanību piesaista 16 gadus vecā Kloda sacerējums, kurā jaunietis neparasti vērīgi apraksta klasesbiedra Rafa ģimenes ikdienu. Ieinteresēts par talantīgā skolēna rakstīšanas spējām, Žermēns mudina viņu turpināt stāstu, un Klods arvien dziļāk iesaistās Rafa ģimenes dzīvē, regulāri apmeklējot viņu mājas. Ar katru nākamo sacerējumu skolotājs kļūst arvien vairāk ieintriģēts, taču drīz vien robeža starp patiesību un izdomu sāk izplūst. Kloda stāsts pamazām pārvēršas spēlē, kurā iesaistīti ne tikai viņa klasesbiedra tuvinieki, bet arī pats skolotājs. Cik tālu Klods būs gatavs iet savas ieceres vārdā, un vai Žermēns laikus pamanīs, ka viņa skolnieks manipulē ne tikai ar stāsta varoņiem, bet arī ar viņu pašu?

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship
programme.desc: Mmm … can you smell it? The sweet aroma of cinnamon rolls baking in the oven, or is it the pumpkin-spiced latte you're sipping? For the preheat, host Jesse Palmer asks the bakers to combine two of the fall season's best treats and make seasonal coffee drink cinnamon rolls. Then, the bakers roll right into the main heat with a fall-themed yule log that Jesse calls Thanksgiving Swiss Rolls. In the end, judges Carla Hall, Duff Goldman and Nancy Fuller decide which baker is rolling home.

programme.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programme.desc: Say cheese! The reigning champion defends their title against chefs Jamie Tran and Isaac Toups as they prove to judges Jet Tila and Antonia Lofaso that they can handle the cheesy curveballs and dairy-driven twists of Guy Fieri's Flavortown restaurants.

programme.title: 24 In
programme.desc: Michael Symon and Esther Choi ask the eight remaining chefs to battle in teams of four, and the winning team gets some well-deserved rest. The losing team must make their best late-night eats for judges Brooke Williamson and Ayesha Nurdjaja.

programme.title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
programme.desc: A passionate Peruvian father is clinging to old-country recipes and control of his collapsing business while keeping his two sons in the dark. Jen Agg and Aarón Sánchez give the tough love necessary to inspire change for a demanding new reality and give his sons the confidence to prove they can take the reins.

programme.title: Restaurant Impossible: Last Call
programme.desc: Jen Agg and Aarón Sánchez come to the rescue of a proud Italian immigrant who believed that overflowing plates and a full stomach would guarantee a full dining room. But empty tables and disappearing pension funds tell a different story.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.desc: This trip, Guy's filling up on some serious soup. In Baltimore, the authentic Irish pub serving up seafood gumbo and a twist on traditional corned beef and cabbage. In Eugene, Ore., the joint dishing out 80 different kinds of soup, from a Middle Eastern take on lamb to Peruvian pork and quinoa. And in Cincinnati, the Vietnamese spot cranking out phenomenal pho and a bahn mi sandwich turned on its head.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

In Des Moines, Iowa, the trophy-winning barbecue joint smokin' up all kinds of unique wings and dishin' out an out-of-bounds apple dumpling dessert. Across town in West Des Moines, a real deal Ecuadorian spot cookin' up authentic specialties like chicken with rice and pork with hominy. And in Eugene, Oregon, the seafood market servin' up totally fresh caught Dungeness crab and a legit cajun crawfish pie.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Flavortown Food Fight
programme.desc: Say cheese! The reigning champion defends their title against chefs Jamie Tran and Isaac Toups as they prove to judges Jet Tila and Antonia Lofaso that they can handle the cheesy curveballs and dairy-driven twists of Guy Fieri's Flavortown restaurants.

programme.title: 24 In
programme.desc: Michael Symon and Esther Choi ask the eight remaining chefs to battle in teams of four, and the winning team gets some well-deserved rest. The losing team must make their best late-night eats for judges Brooke Williamson and Ayesha Nurdjaja.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Carlo's Bakery in Hoboken New Jersey create elaborate, elegant and interesting edible art cakes. Cake Boss follows the team, led by Buddy Valastro, as they design and create two of these masterpieces for all kinds of events and occassions. The show explores the intricacy of working with your family, and their interpersonal relationships with other employees. Watch as they create everything from classic wedding cakes to alien spaceships.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: At the end of the workday, Ree Drummond and her team are having a casual office-warming party at their new space in town. For the appetizer menu, Ree makes Maple Bacon Dip with Apples, easy Italian Cheese Sticks and Marinara Sauce with a store-bought shortcut and Greek Guacamole with tortilla chips and cucumber rounds. She also has seafood-lovers covered with classic Crab Rangoon Dip and Fried Wontons. Finally, Ree adds some sparkle to the party with glamorous Strawberry Rose Bellinis.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is making a special meal to deliver to Beverly, the curator of the Drummond family's historic home and museum. She makes a delicious, edible thank you package featuring recipes from Addie Drummond, the home's original owner. Ree mixes her own recipes with originals from Addie, making Grape Lemonade, Old-Fashioned Chicken Stew, Brown Bread and Lemon and Raspberry Cream Cake. Beverly shows Ree the house and some of its treasures and gives her a peek into the life of the original owners.

programme.title: Outchef'd
programme.desc: Host Eddie Jackson gives everyday home cooks the shock of their lives when he reveals that they've actually shown up not to audition, but to face off in a one-on-one cooking challenge against culinary greats like Alex Guarnaschelli, Geoffrey Zakarian and Anne Burrell.

programme.title: Street Food In Africa
programme.desc: Join famous Chef Nti on her journey through Africa, bound to tantalize your taste buds, as she introduces the variety of African cuisine and showcases a number of popular street food in Africa. The first show to represent and promote globally rich culinary heritage of Chef Nti's country, South Africa, hoping to expand to other parts of Africa and share more delicious stories with the viewers. The chef will also recreate famous dishes in her own kitchen and share her tips and trick in preparing them.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

Nothing is out of bounds when money changes hands and we see just how far chefs will go to ensure they have the winning dish.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives

Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Christmas Cookie Challenge
programme.desc: Our favorite Christmas traditions go way back, and now five of the best cookie makers take it way, waaaaay back with holiday cookies from when dinosaurs roamed the Earth. Hosts Ree Drummond and Eddie Jackson decide which competitor is left in the past before challenging the bakers to craft 3D cookie vehicles for getting around the North Pole. Balloons, boats and scooters will be part of Santa's new fleet for beating the sleet, fueled with tasty soda pop flavors like orange, grape, black cherry and birch beer.

programme.title: Holiday Baking Championship
programme.desc: The search to find the greatest holiday baker begins as eight amateur bakers enter the kitchen, where they show off their family traditions and superb baking skills. To survive the challenges from week to week, they must prove their abilities in front of our tough-love judges: Duff Goldman, Nancy Fuller and Lorraine Pascale. Hosted by Bobby Deen, this baking championship is the sweetest way to celebrate this holiday season.

programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: Selena Gomez's culinary duty brings her to the kitchen of Los Angeles restaurant royalty! Dumpling Queen Shirley Chung welcomes Selena into Ms Chi, where the two make a fusion version of a beloved dish from Selena's childhood. Selena, Raquelle and Shirley fold dumplings, smoke chicken with tea-leaves and dance around the kitchen before Selena attempts to deliver a dish good enough to make the menu.

programme.title: Selena + Restaurant
programme.desc: Selena Gomez and Raquelle head to Alta, Chef Keith Corbin's California soul food restaurant. For the kitchen initiation, Corbin puts Selena under pressure with some short order egg cooking, and she quickly learns it's not nearly as simple as it sounds. Once she's proven her mettle, Selena attempts to make a fried fish dish tasty enough for Alta's menu and the restaurant's toughest critic, Renee Corbin.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is sharing four recipes for chicken that are ranch favorites. First, the versatile protein is roasted in White Chicken Enchiladas, a Tex-Mex classic perfect for stocking up the freezer. Second, her Crispy Chicken Florentine Melt is a pure treasure from a fridge raid. Third, Ree puts chicken thighs in the spotlight in her all-in-one Italian Chicken Sheet Pan Supper, and finally, she makes a meal kit with marinated chicken and noodles transformed in minutes for her Teriyaki Chicken with Sesame Noodles.

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: Fuhrer 2.0
programme.desc: Is history repeating itself before our eyes? A documentary examines the shocking similarities between two dictators, Adolf Hitler and Vladimir Putin. Despite a 66-year age gap, their methods are identical: from the suppression of freedoms and nationalist propaganda to bloody wars of aggression. programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: The documentary film "Sisters" tells the story of humanity, compassion, and the power of support that help Ukrainians overcome the pain of loss during war. The film shows the stories of women who, having experienced their own tragedy, turned their pain into a good deed. Twin sisters from Dnipro launched a volunteer project "Search with Love and Hope" to care for the graves of Ukrainian soldiers whose families cannot come to the burial sites. The film is not only a story of loss, but also of deep solidarity and gratitude. It reminds us that even in the most difficult times, Ukrainians stick together, support each other, and honor those who gave their lives for freedom.

programme.title: Fuhrer 2.0
programme.desc: Is history repeating itself before our eyes? A documentary examines the shocking similarities between two dictators, Adolf Hitler and Vladimir Putin. Despite a 66-year age gap, their methods are identical: from the suppression of freedoms and nationalist propaganda to bloody wars of aggression. The filmmakers explore how childhood trauma and domestic violence shaped the characters of future tyrants, and compare their military strategies—from the devastation of World War II to modern aggression in Ukraine, Georgia, and Syria. A deep psychological portrait of those who brought the world to the brink of disaster.

programme.title: Grāfs Monte-Kristo
programme.desc: Izbēdzis no cietuma uz salas, kurā, nepatiesi apsūdzēts par valsts nodevību, pavadījis četrpadsmit gadus, Edmunds Dantess atgriežas kā grāfs Monte-Kristo, lai atriebtos vīriem, kas viņu nodevuši.

programme.title: Raileina
programme.desc: Tikko piedzīvojuši sāpīgas šķiršanās, divi jaunieši pavada piedzīvojumiem bagātu dienu Londonas dienvidu daļā.

programme.title: Modes aizkulises
programme.desc: Amerikāņu kinorežisore ierodas Parīzē uz modes nedēļu, taču vienlaikus dodas dzīvības un nāves ceļojumā un saskaras ar izaicinājumiem un sevis izzināšanu.

programme.title: Deviņas lodes
programme.desc: Burlesku dejotāja riskē ar visu, lai glābtu mazu zēnu, kura ģimeni nogalinājis viņas bijušais draugs. Meitene apņemas aizvest traģēdijā izdzīvojušo zēnu sveiku un veselu pie tēvoča Dienviddakotā. Nežēlīgais noziedznieks negrasās atstāt vienīgo liecinieku dzīvu un nosūta bandītus abus medīt.

programme.title: Ledus laikmets: Lielā sadursme
programme.desc: Skreta (Kriss Vedžs) nepārtrauktie pūliņi noglabāt savu zīli liek viņam izraisīt negadījumu virkni, kuru rezultātā asteroīdi sāk traukties uz Zemi. Haoss liek Manijam (Rejs Romano), Djego (Deniss Līrijs), Sidam (Džons Legvizamo) un viņu ģimenēm meklēt patvērumu. Piedzīvojumu meklētāja zebiekste Baks (Saimons Pegs) viņus brīdina, ka var sākties masveida izmiršana, kas liek draugiem meklēt jaunu mājvietu, pa ceļam satiekot citus dzīvniekus un apmeklējot eksotiskas vietas.

programme.title: Nejaukais es
programme.desc: Kamēr bijušais dižais ļaundaris Gru sāk iejusties ģimenes cilvēka lomā un mēģina godīgi pelnīt iztiku, pārdodot ievārījumu, Antarktīdā kāds nozog slepenu laboratoriju. Ļaunuma apkarošanas organizācijai ir nepieciešama palīdzība, un tās pārstāvji ierodas pie Gru. Kopā ar organizācijas ekscentrisko aģenti Lūsiju Vaildu viņš secina, ka galvenais aizdomās turamais ir par mirušu uzskatītais supernelietis El Mačo, kura dēls ir ieskatījies Gru vecākajā meitā Margo. Pārlieka vēlēšanās pasargāt meitas un arvien pieaugošās simpātijas pret Lūsiju aizmiglo Gru prātu, tādēļ meklējumi nevedas. Tikmēr kāds nelietis paklusām nolaupa Gru palīgus.

programme.title: Kapteinis Zobenzobs un burvju briljants
programme.desc: Ļaunais princis Megans Hans no džungļiem un Karību jūras pirāts kapteinis Zobenzobs jau sen dzen maģiskā briljanta pēdas. Tas nav parasts dārgakmens. Pusnaktī tas spēj piepildīt viskvēlāko vēlēšanos, lai kāda tā būtu. Visi meklējumi "kaķim zem astes", taču tad, klejodams pa džungļiem, burvju dārgakmeni nejauši ierauga mazais Marks.

programme.title: Kaut tu būtu šeit
programme.desc: Jauna dāma, meklējot dzīvei uguntiņu, pavada romantisku nakti kopā ar kādu jaunekli. Atklādama, ka vīrietis ir nedziedināmi slims, sieviete apņemas palīdzēt viņam pilnvērtīgi nodzīvot pēdējās šeit atvēlētās dienas.

programme.title: Gariem līdzi
programme.desc: Kad Čihiro vecāki tiek pārvērsti cūkās, viņa spiesta strādāt pirtī, kuru vada ragana. Starp gariem un brīnumainām būtnēm viņa atrod drosmi un labestību. "Ghibli" šedevrs apbur ar emocijām.

programme.title: Zirnekļcilvēks: Tālu no mājām
programme.desc: Pīters Pārkers joprojām sēro par sava mentora Tonija Starka zaudējumu un cenšas atgriezties parasta pusaudža dzīvē. Viņš kopā ar klasesbiedriem dodas skolas ekskursijā uz Eiropu, cerot uz laiku nolikt malā supervaroņa kostīmu, izbaudīt Venēciju, Parīzi un Londonu, un beidzot atzīties mīlestībā Emdžejai. Tomēr Pītera plāni sabrūk, kad viņu uzmeklē Niks Furijs. Eiropas pilsētām uzbrūk noslēpumaini radījumi Elementāļi, kas spēj izsaukt dabas katastrofas. Pīteram nākas apvienot spēkus ar jaunu sabiedroto no paralēlās dimensijas Kventinu Beku, kuru pasaule iepazīst kā Misterio. Pīteram ir jāizlemj, vai viņš ir gatavs kļūt par nākamo "Dzelzs vīru" pasaulē, kas ir neatgriezeniski mainījusies, un jāmācās atšķirt patiesību no ilūzijas.

programme.title: Haralds un burvju krītiņš
programme.desc: Savā grāmatā piedzīvojumu kārais Haralds var atdzīvināt jebko, to vienkārši uzzīmējot. Pieaugot un attālinoties no grāmatas lappusēm un nonākot reālajā pasaulē, Haralds saprot, ka viņam ir daudz jāmācās par īsto dzīvi.

programme.title: Debesis patiešām ir īstas
programme.desc: Kādam mazpilsētas tēvam jāatrod drosme un pārliecība pastāstīt pasaulei par sava mazā dēla īpašo, dzīvi mainošo pieredzējumu.

programme.title: Viņa brauc ar bisi
programme.desc: Nāvei nolemta jauna meitene metas bēgt un mācās izdzīvot no pēdējā cilvēka, kam uzticas – sava tēva, bijušā ieslodzītā.

programme.title: Mazulīte
programme.desc: Augsta līmeņa vadītāja liek uz spēles savu karjeru un ģimeni, kad sāk kaislīgas attiecības ar krietni jaunāku praktikantu.

programme.title: Melnais telefons
programme.desc: Finns tagad ir septiņpadsmit gadus vecs. Kamēr viņš mēģina tikt galā ar savu dzīvi pēc nolaupīšanas, Finna māsa sapņos sāk saņemt zvanus no melna telefona un redz vīzijas par trim zēniem, kurus kāds izseko ziemas nometnē Alpīnleikā.

programme.title: Kentervilas spoks
programme.desc: Sera Saimona de Kentervila rēgs jau 300 gadus klīst pa savrupmāju, meklēdams drosmīgu pēcnācēju, kurš viņu varētu atbrīvot no lāsta. Kad šajā savrupmājā ievācas kāda amerikāņu ģimene, spokam parādās cerību stariņš beidzot tapt atbrīvotam.

programme.title: Kā pieradināt pūķi
programme.desc: Skarbajā Berkas salā vikingi un pūķi ir bijuši ienaidnieki paaudžu paaudzēs. Šeit dzīvo Hikaps - jaunietis ar izgudrotāja spējām, varenā vikinga Lielā Stoika dēls. Hikaps pārkāpj gadsimtiem ilgas tradīcijas, sadraudzējoties ar Nezobu - mītiem apvīto Tumsas pūķi. Viņu neticamā draudzība atklās pūķu patieso dabu un pavērs ceļu jaunai ērai pūķu un vikingu pasaulē.

programme.title: Viesnīca Transilvānija
programme.desc: Laipni lūgti viesnīcā "Transilvānija", Drakulas krāšņajā pieczobu kūrortā, kurā monstri var izbaudīt nesteidzīgu atpūtu. Ir pienākusi īpaša nedēļas nogale, kuras laikā Drakula ir ielūdzis ciemos dažus no saviem labākajiem draugiem. Ir plānots svinēt Drakulas meitas Meivisas pilngadību – 118. dzimšanas dienu. Uzņemt tik kuplu viesu pulku Drakulas ģimenei nav problēma. Tomēr jukas izceļas, kad viesnīcā ieklīst parasts puisis un ieskatās viņa meitā.

programme.title: Ceļojošā Pils
programme.desc: Kad Sofija tiek pārvērsta par sirmgalvi, viņa bēg no pilsētas un atrod patvērumu Houla maģiskajā pilī. Starp lidojošām pilsētām un kara draudiem viņa atklāj mīlestību un drosmi. Studijas "Ghibli" šedevrs ir sirsnīga un burvīga pasaka.

programme.title: Mans kaimiņš Totoro
programme.desc: Kad smagi saslimst māte, māsas pārceļas uz dzīvi laukos, lai atrastos tuvāk mammai. Piedzīvojumā iesaistās brīnumaini meža gari, kuri arī apdzīvo tuvējo apkaimi.

programme.title: Viesnīca Transilvānija 3
programme.desc: Monstru ģimene šoreiz dodas brīvdienās. Luksusa kruīza kuģis aizvedīs Drakulu prom no rūpēm par viesnīcas apmeklētāju labsajūtu. Un kas ir atpūta bez draugiem, kuri tāpat ar prieku metas baudīt kuģa sniegtās izklaides! Taču, kad Drakula iemīlas noslēpumainajā kapteinē Ērikā, viņš vēl nenojauš, ka Ērika ir monstru lielākā ienaidnieka Ābrahama van Helsinga pēctece un sākas mošķu cienīga drāma.

programme.title: Atzīstiet manu vainu
programme.desc: Kad policijai beidzot izdodas arestēt divdesmit Lukēzi mafijas klana locekļus, Džekijs Dinoršio, ar iesauku Resnais, kurš jau izcieš 30 gadu cietumsodu, saņem vilinošu piedāvājumu – Džekiju atbrīvos priekšlaicīgi, ja viņš liecinās pret saviem draugiem. Bet Resnais Di nav nodevējs! Tiesas procesā, kas izrādīsies garākais un skandalozākais ASV tiesu praksē, Džekijs sevi aizstāvēs pats.

programme.title: Omen: Pirmais pareģojums
programme.desc: Jauna amerikāniete tiek nosūtīta uz Romu, lai sāktu kalpošanu baznīcai, taču viņa saskaras ar kaut ko, kas liek viņai apšaubīt savu ticību un atklāt šausminošu sazvērestību, kuras mērķis ir izraisīt ļaunuma dzimšanu.

programme.title: Spēka balāde
programme.desc: Kad Riks, kāzu dziedātājs, kurš jau sen ir pāri savam karjeras zenītam, kādā pasākumā satiek izbijušu zvaigzni Deniju, viņi satuvinās, daloties mūzikā un nakts vidus improvizācijās. Taču, kad Denijs pārvērš vienu no Rika dziesmām par hitu, kas atdzīvina viņa karjeru, Riks nolemj nopelnīt atzinību, ko, viņaprāt, ir pelnījis - pat ja tas nozīmē riskēt ar visu, kas viņam ir svarīgs.

programme.title: Īstas sāpes
programme.desc: Tik ļoti atšķirīgie un sen netikušies brālēni Deivids un Bendžijs atkal apvienojas ceļojumā uz Poliju, lai godinātu savu mirušo vecmāmiņu. Viņu piedzīvojums uzņem jaunus apgriezienus, kad neparastā pārīša seno dienu neatrisinātās pretrunas un sarežģītās attiecības atdzimst uz ģimenes vēstures fona.

programme.title: Futbols: LaLiga. Real Madrid - Celta
programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. It is administered by the National Professional Football League and has 20 contestants, with the three lowest-placed teams at the end of each season relegated to the Segunda División and replaced by the top two teams and a play-off winner in that division. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Basketbols: Eirolīga. Maccabi - Dubai
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.desc: Martial Arts based TV programme. UFC stands for the Ultimate Fighting Championship which is an American mixed martial arts (MMA) promotion company based in Las Vegas that is owned by William Morris Endeavour.The purpose of UFC fighting was to establish the most effective martial art in a contest that had no weight classes and minimal rules that were as follows: no biting, hair pulling, groin shots and eye gouging. Legendary fighters well known for their ability to win in UFC fighting are Anderson Silva, Brock Lesnar, Connor McGregor and Ken Shamrock. programme.title: Basketbols: Eirolīga. Olympiacos - Real Madrid
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: House Hunters
programme.desc: American reality series following host Suzanne Whang on her quest to help people relocate in search of their dream home. Follow the individuals, couples and families in an international search for their perfect property, exploring a stunning selection of homes chosen just for them. With three potential candidates to choose from, join them as they try and make the difficult decision to start a new life abroad. Revisit the new homeowners at the end of each episode to see how their properties have developed and how life has changed for them since the move.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens: Origins
programme.desc: Ancient sites like Stonehenge, Newgrange, and Egypt's Pyramids of Giza reveal astonishing celestial alignments that seem far from coincidence. Across the globe, from the Mayan temples and Hopi settlements to the pyramid complex of Teotihuacan, massive structures seem to mirror the heavens above–especially when seen from the skies. What purpose do they serve? Were these alignments crafted to signal entities from the stars? Do they mark the origins of otherworldly visitors? Or do they conceal a hidden purpose–one that humanity has yet to uncover?

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: Stories of great impostors are both daring and baffling. What compels a person to attempt to become someone else? Is it merely for material gain, or to pull off an ingenious scam? When does the line between impersonation and transformation get blurred? Is it possible that by pretending to be someone else, a person can actually become that person, at least in their mind?

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: A&E presents the new original real-life series "Storage Wars," which follows professional buyers and their teams as they scour repossessed storage units in search of hidden treasure. Part gamblers, part detectives, these auction pros have found everything from coffins to the world's most valuable comic book collection, paying as little as ten dollars for items valued in the millions. Each episode of "Storage Wars" follows a group of bidders as they get a quick peek inside the units, aided only by the beam of a flashlight. They then must assess on the spot if the unit is worth a bid and how high they will actually go to grasp the gold. The high-stakes fun begins as we see if the resulting buy is full of mostly trash... or true treasure. Driven by Dan Dotson, one of the most successful and outrageous auctioneers in the country, the cast of buyers is as colorful and varied as the treasures they uncover.

programme.title: Greatest Mysteries with Laurence Fishburne
programme.desc: The Tower of Babel, Sodom and Gomorrah, Mount Sinai are some of the greatest Old Testament stories ever told. Yet these iconic places have seemingly vanished from the map. If found, these venerated sites could reveal much about humanity's ancient past. And many scholars believe the Book of Genesis is filled with clues...if you know where to look. Where are the Old Testament's legendary lost places--and what might they reveal?

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: When an outfit supposedly worn by Alice Cooper hits the counter, it'll be "No More Mr. Nice Guy" as Rick tries to land a deal. Then, Chum gets mercenary when he makes an offer on a 7-foot tall Deadpool PEZ dispenser. Will the seller accept, or is it all a joke to them? After, Rick and Chum trade looks at sheets of MetaZoo cards with an old adversary--will Rick get burned on a deal again? And later, Rick and Corey go for the gold on a sale of a 1988 Winter Olympics torch. But will they cross the finish line?

programme.title: UFO Hunters
programme.desc: The team's access to UFO evidence is unparalleled and their expertise allows them to quickly identify bogus claims of UFOs. Together, they use eyewitness accounts, scientific experimentation, documents recently released through the Freedom of Information Act and footage that has never been seen before on television to piece together compelling — and at times chilling — evidence of UFO phenomena. Join UFO Hunters Bill Birnes, Pat Uskert, Dr. Ted Acworth, and Jeff Tomlinson as they separate fact from fallacy.

programme.title: Missing in Alaska
programme.desc: The Alaska Triangle, a region in northwest Alaska, has more unsolved missing person cases than anywhere else in the world. Over 20,000 people have vanished in the past 50 years alone. Who or what's behind these cases is unknown. Some believe it's the work of local predators or simply the rugged, dangerous terrain, but legends thrive in Alaska, and the ominous history of disappearances in the area has drawn comparisons to the Bermuda Triangle. Working together with local experts and eyewitnesses, our team of investigators will go case-by-case to gather evidence, conduct tests, examine history and explore local myths to determine the most viable explanation for the disappearances, all while trying to understand the sinister mystery that is the Alaska Triangle.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: Warriors
programme.desc: Warriors goes inside the culture of the most famous warriors of all time to explore their weaponry, tactics, training and, ultimately, their psyche. Every episode tells the dramatic story of one of the world's iconic warrior groups--Vikings, Spartans, Barbarians, Samurai--including the rituals, technology and strategy that made them so mighty. Warriors is hosted by Terry Schappert, a Green Beret and 17-year veteran currently serving in the US Special Forces. He delves deep into the mindset of a warrior, revealing what made these individuals rise above others to lead, to fight and sometimes to die. Each Warriors episode also explores a climactic battle that showcases the warrior's strengths, weaknesses and life-and-death struggle. From Zulus to English Knights to Hawaiians, Terry is fully immersed in the warrior culture--from the weapons used to the pre-battle rituals, to the initiations, to battlefield strategy and tactics. When delving deep into the Viking culture, he experiences first hand the fighting techniques and tests the weapons of the warriors that some call "the Hells Angels" of the Middle Ages. In the Samurai episode, Terry learns the secrets and traditions of the elite and mysterious warriors who for centuries ruled Japan. In English Knights, he dons the armor, uses the weapons and lives the code of chivalry. In every episode of Warriors, Terry talks to experts on each of the warrior cultures, moves beyond the stereotypes and gains new insights about who these men really were. Walking in the footsteps of history's greatest Warriors proves to be a gut-wrenching experience, but it's all part of Terry's amazing journey to discover the heart of a warrior.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: Bob Baer and Dr. John Cencic continue their investigation into the death of Adolf Hitler and sending teams to three countries: Germany, Spain and Argentina. Lenny DePaul and Sascha Keil find a never before exposed tunnel from Hitler's bunker leads directly to Tempelhof airport, where Hitler's private plane awaited him. Tim Kennedy joins an elite team of archaeologists sea in a search for a possible German submarine off the coast of Argentina. Lenny will investigate along with Gerrard Williams or possibly Hitler arrived in Spain, where he was hiding with the help of the Spanish dictator Francisco Franco.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. The first three seasons of the show focused on host Josh Bernstein, who journeyed on various explorations of historical icons and mysteries. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

programme.title: MonsterQuest
programme.desc: From Bigfoot to Swamp Beast, Monster Quest reveals the truth of legendary monster sightings around the world. Deploying the latest in hi-tech equipment, each episode scientifically examines the best evidence available, from pictures and video, to hair and bones, as well as the eyewitness accounts themselves. From pilots to policemen to ship captains, a number of seemingly credible people have seen things they can't explain. One part history, one part science and one part monsters, Monster Quest discovers the truth behind these legendary monsters.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: Bob Baer and Dr. John Cencich send Lenny DePaul and Gerrard Williams to Spain, where they investigate a remote monastery that could have been a hiding place for Nazis and uncover an eyewitness that places Hitler living within those very walls. Further investigation leads the team to a mysterious German plane landing and nearby Nazi communication devices deep in Spain. Tim Kennedy prepares to dive for what could be a sunken German U-Boat off the coast of Argentina. Ultimately the team is led to the Canary Islands, where they uncover a possible Enigma machine and tunnels used to supply German U-boats with torpedoes.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. The first three seasons of the show focused on host Josh Bernstein, who journeyed on various explorations of historical icons and mysteries. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens

programme.title: Ancient Aliens

programme.title: Ancient Aliens

Through the victim's words, viewers come to understand the emotional damage endured as well as the significance of the life that was taken.

programme.title: Hear No Evil
programme.desc: As opposed to its sister series ''See No Evil,'' which details unlawful activity rooted out with the aid of surveillance cameras, ''Hear No Evil'' uses authentic audio recorded at crime scenes to build each episode's narrative. The recordings, captured by victims' families, investigators and the killers themselves, reconstruct the murderous acts with the aid of first-person testimony, stylized re-enactments and video archive. The result is a series that ultimately lets viewers' imaginations and instinctive fears of the unknown come to the fore.

programme.title: Toxic
programme.desc: For nearly two decades, Tausha Haight endures emotional and psychological abuse from her seemingly perfect husband, Michael, who hides a darker reality. When she finally fights to leave, escalating red flags put Tausha and her five children in danger.

programme.title: Blood Runs Cold
programme.desc: This fascinating true crime documentary series follows families who, riddled with grief, have gone above and beyond to ensure the killers of their loved ones see justice. These inspiring individuals, sometimes with police officers by their side, go to unfathomable lengths to catch the wanted perpetrators, trying to find new evidence or witnesses to help crack the case and catch the killer on the loose.

programme.title: Grave Mysteries
programme.desc: Law enforcement officials investigate mysterious deaths across America in this true-crime documentary series, where the evidence and identity of the murderer is linked to online activity. Following a trail of online breadcrumbs, these investigators trawl through victims' internet histories to identify any possible clues to their murder. What they find is shocking, and the crime begins to unravel the deeper they dig. With dramatic reconstructions and first-person testimonies, each episode explores a different, heinous crime, one that has ultimately led to a tragic loss of life.

programme.title: Border Control Poland
programme.desc: The shocking, emotional, and surprising real-life action that takes place at Poland's border crossings. The security and customs services reveal how they deal with the most bizarre and dangerous situations to keep Poland safe.

programme.title: Body Cam
programme.desc: Documentary series following police officers across the USA as they put their lives on the line to enforce the law. Using real footage from the officer's body cameras, we show just how deadly routine checks can be, with law enforcement officials having to think on their feet and make split-second decisions to potentially save their, or someone else's, life. From knife-wielding maniacs to brutal shootouts, the series highlights the importance of our police departments. With interviews from the officers involved adding context to the footage, Body Cam Cops gives viewers unprecedented, exclusive access to what life is truly like in the line of duty.

programme.title: Devil Among Us
programme.desc: When an attack happens, investigators must first consider motive. All too often, the true identity of a killer is masked by a twisted web of deceit in which revenge and hate are the fuel feeding their dark souls. Hiding in plain sight, they can spend years in the shadows before finally being caught - a single clue unlocking a Pandora's box of haunting tales of terror, loathing and fear. As identities are revealed, a chain is completed - uncovering a grim series of interconnected crimes and a trail of suffering in their wake that haunts communities and loved ones for decades.

programme.title: American Monster
programme.desc: If you looked into the eyes of a killer, would you know? In American Monster, you find out. For the first time, viewers get closer than ever to some of America's most shocking and surprising crimes. Filled with never-before-seen footage of these devils in disguise, from home movie shots of them playing with their kids to musical performances at high school, from the church cook-out to the wedding video, American Monster interweaves twisting-turning stories of astonishing crimes, with 'behind-the-scenes' footage of killers at their seemingly most innocent.

programme.title: American Monster: Abuse of Power
programme.desc: Alternative therapies make CEO Kimberly Bailey millions, but she suspects her employees are stealing from her. Behind the mask of success lies a paranoid monster. When a close colleague vanishes, the FBI investigation leads to a deadly conclusion.

programme.title: American Monster: Abuse of Power
programme.desc: When the Arkansas Medical Board strikes off popular pain specialist Randeep Mann amid allegations about his practice, they also uncover a monster. He stops at nothing to regain his practice, unleashing an explosive plot to regain power.

programme.title: Southern Fried Homicide
programme.desc: Across the Deep South, heat, humidity and darn good hiding places provide a perfect backdrop for dark, despicable deeds. Southern Fried Homicide transports viewers into the steamy, Southern subculture whose lifestyles and charming drawls are captivating viewers - and covering up crimes. SOUTHERN FRIED HOMICIDE probes the juiciest stories from down in the Bible Belt, from the Carolinas to Louisiana and Tennessee. The premiere episode on June 5 at 10/9C profiles an old adage in the south: families are a bit like fudge - mostly sweet, but with a few nuts. After pedigreed Southern belle Susie Newsom's marriage fails, sweet Susie spirals and starts to have an affair...with her disturbed first cousin. When the rest of the family isn't exactly thrilled with the kissing cousins, their scandalous relationship ends with nine family members dead, spanning from Kentucky to North Carolina. SOUTHERN FRIED HOMICIDE proves that ugliness lurks behind Southern beauty when cracks in moral society give way to cold-blooded murder. Actress Shanna Forrestall, a native belle of Louisiana, serves as the gatekeeper to these salacious stories that give another meaning to things that "go south."

programme.title: I'd Kill for You
programme.desc: Tales of soured romances are explored in this true-crime documentary series, where loved ones turn against each other, leading to fatal consequences. Fraught with jealousy, betrayal, infidelity and anger, each episode focusses on a respective murder, brought to life with dramatic reconstructions and interviews with law enforcement and those with connections to the case. The series examines the incomprehensible outcomes of failing relationships, with emotionally charged partners taking the marital expression, till death do us part, far too literally.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: Crime documentary series that examines homicide investigations using unfiltered footage, including body-cam, surveillance and interrogation-room footage, giving viewers a chance to follow a case from beginning to end. The series will give viewers a chance to experience how homicide cases are conducted, from the initial crime scene investigations by body cam, to home security tapes, to interrogation room footage of real confessions. Real tapes of the investigations will be combined with interviews with friends, family members, and law enforcement directly involved in the case.

programme.desc: Detectives investigate the murder of a 77-year-old grandmother after a mysterious basement fire. The case uncovers family feuds, missing money, and suspicious clues that point to a killer who no one suspects.

programme.title: Выйти из группы
programme.desc: Подросток, находясь в поисках своего места в мире, попадает в группу социальной сети, которая набирает ребят в загадочное братство. Пройдя через серию испытаний, подростки должны доказать, что они особенные. Очередным заданием является реальное убийство. Одумавшись, герой должен спастись от вчерашних "друзей" и разоблачить настоящих преступников.

programme.title: Холивар. История Рунета
programme.desc: Авторский мини-сериал Андрея Лошака рассказывает о том, как возник в России интернет, прозванный "рунетом", и как он со временем менялся. Развитие рунета отразило все социальные и политические изменения в российском обществе: полная свобода в 90-х годах, бурный рост экономики в нулевых и введение цензуры и запретительных законов в десятые. Последние 7 лет государство активно пытается взять "рунет" под контроль.
